---
title: "Configuration"
---

## Precedence

Settings are resolved from lowest to highest precedence:

```text
code defaults  <  autosprint/config.toml  <  environment / .env  <  CLI flags
```

Configuration is managed with `pydantic-settings`. Run `autosprint settings` to
see the fully-resolved values, and `autosprint config-keys` to list every key.

## Key settings

| Key                        | Meaning                                                                      |
| -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `TEAM`                     | Planning team name (a key in `teams.TEAMS`).                                 |
| `IMPLEMENT_AGENT`          | Agent used for the Implement phase (a key in `agents.AGENTS`).               |
| `HOWFAR_AGENT`             | Agent used by `autosprint how-far`.                                          |
| `MAX_SPRINTS`              | Sprint limit. In reviewed-plan mode it auto-sizes from `plan.md` when unset. |
| `MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES` | Consecutive-failure limit before the loop stops.                             |
| `TARGET_REPO`              | Dev/debug fallback path; normal use targets the cwd or `--target`.           |
| `LOG_LEVEL`                | `1` = debug/hardcoded task; `15` = use cache; `50+` = full production mode.  |

## Test runner

Autosprint normalises test execution across languages through a `TestRunner`
adapter (see `infra/test_runners.py`).

| Key                           | Meaning                                                                                             |
| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `TARGET_TEST_RUNNER`          | `auto` \| `pytest` \| `vitest`; `auto` detects from the target's marker files.                      |
| `TEST_COMMAND`                | Optional override of the run command.                                                               |
| `IMPLEMENT_TESTS_FAST_MARKER` | Marker expression for the Implement agent's inline self-check (default `"not slow"`).               |
| `TEST_PHASE_QUICK_ONLY`       | If true, the Test phase runs only the quick subset each sprint (default false runs the full suite). |

Mark slow tests in the target repo with `@pytest.mark.slow` so the fast subset
stays fast.

## Per-sprint gates

Beyond the test suite, optional quality gates run before a sprint's changes are
accepted (import-check, smoke-test, format-check, lint-check, collect-only,
coverage-track). Each gate is `active`, `off`, or `auto-skipped` (enabled but
missing tooling). Inspect the live state with:

```bash
autosprint gates
```

`auto` gates safely skip themselves when the required tooling is absent, so the
same config works across very different target repos.
